title: The global search PR queried MailAccount and MailRule with plain .objects.filter() behind only a model-level has_perm check, unlike the owner-aware get_objects_for_user_owner_aware() it used for tags and correspondents, so users see other users' mail accounts and rules.

findings.explanation: The user‑controlled `query` parameter is passed to Django ORM's `filter(name__icontains=query)`, which uses parameterised SQL and does not concatenate raw strings into the query.

Object retrieval is now performed via `get_objects_for_user_owner_aware`, which is intended to return only objects the requesting user is permitted to view based on ownership and the `view_mailrule` / `view_mailaccount` permissions. The preceding `has_perm` check further ensures the user has the required global permission before any objects are returned.
